---- MODULE OpenAddressing ----
EXTENDS OpenAddressingDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS
LOCAL T == INSTANCE TLAPS
LOCAL FS == INSTANCE FiniteSetTheorems
LOCAL FSE == INSTANCE FiniteSetsExt
LOCAL FSET == INSTANCE FiniteSetsExtTheorems

THEOREM BridgeFin == \A S : FS!IsFiniteSet(S) <=> IsFiniteSet(S)
  BY DEF FS!IsFiniteSet, IsFiniteSet
THEOREM BridgeCard == \A S : FS!Cardinality(S) = Cardinality(S)
  BY DEF FS!Cardinality, Cardinality
THEOREM BridgeMax == \A S : max(S) = FSE!Max(S)
  BY DEF max, FSE!Max
THEOREM BridgeMin == \A S : min(S) = FSE!Min(S)
  BY DEF min, FSE!Min
THEOREM BridgeFSETMax == \A S : FSET!Max(S) = FSE!Max(S)
  BY DEF FSET!Max, FSE!Max
THEOREM BridgeFSETMin == \A S : FSET!Min(S) = FSE!Min(S)
  BY DEF FSET!Min, FSE!Min
THEOREM BridgeFSETFin == \A S : FSET!IsFiniteSet(S) <=> IsFiniteSet(S)
  BY DEF FSET!IsFiniteSet, IsFiniteSet
THEOREM BridgeFSETCard == \A S : FSET!Cardinality(S) = Cardinality(S)
  BY DEF FSET!Cardinality, Cardinality

LEMMA FpsSubsetInt == fps \in SUBSET Int
  BY OAAssumption, T!SMTT("r30")
LEMMA FpsFinite == IsFiniteSet(fps)
  BY OAAssumption, T!SMTT("r30")
LEMMA FpsNonEmpty == fps # {}
<1>1. Cardinality(fps) # 0 BY OAAssumption, T!SMTT("r30")
<1>2. QED BY <1>1, FpsFinite, BridgeFin, BridgeCard, FS!FS_EmptySet, T!SMTT("r30")
LEMMA MaxFpsIn == FSET!Max(fps) \in fps
<1>1. FSET!IsFiniteSet(fps) BY FpsFinite, BridgeFSETFin, T!SMTT("r30")
<1>2. QED BY <1>1, FpsSubsetInt, FpsNonEmpty, FSET!MaxIntFinite, T!SMTT("r30")
LEMMA MinFpsIn == FSET!Min(fps) \in fps
<1>1. FSET!IsFiniteSet(fps) BY FpsFinite, BridgeFSETFin, T!SMTT("r30")
<1>2. QED BY <1>1, FpsSubsetInt, FpsNonEmpty, FSET!MinIntFinite, T!SMTT("r30")
LEMMA MaxFpsGe == \A y \in fps : FSET!Max(fps) >= y
<1>1. FSET!IsFiniteSet(fps) BY FpsFinite, BridgeFSETFin, T!SMTT("r30")
<1>2. QED BY <1>1, FpsSubsetInt, FpsNonEmpty, FSET!MaxIntFinite, T!SMTT("r30")
LEMMA MinFpsLe == \A y \in fps : FSET!Min(fps) <= y
<1>1. FSET!IsFiniteSet(fps) BY FpsFinite, BridgeFSETFin, T!SMTT("r30")
<1>2. QED BY <1>1, FpsSubsetInt, FpsNonEmpty, FSET!MinIntFinite, T!SMTT("r30")
LEMMA MaxFpsInt == max(fps) \in Int
<1>1. max(fps) = FSET!Max(fps) BY BridgeMax, BridgeFSETMax, T!SMTT("r30")
<1>2. QED BY <1>1, MaxFpsIn, FpsSubsetInt, T!SMTT("r30")
LEMMA MinFpsInt == min(fps) \in Int
<1>1. min(fps) = FSET!Min(fps) BY BridgeMin, BridgeFSETMin, T!SMTT("r30")
<1>2. QED BY <1>1, MinFpsIn, FpsSubsetInt, T!SMTT("r30")
LEMMA AntiSym == \A a \in Int : \A b \in Int : (a <= b /\ b <= a) => a = b
  BY T!SMTT("r30")
LEMMA MaxGtMin == max(fps) > min(fps)
<1>1. max(fps) >= min(fps)
  <2>1. min(fps) = FSET!Min(fps) BY BridgeMin, BridgeFSETMin, T!SMTT("r30")
  <2>2. max(fps) = FSET!Max(fps) BY BridgeMax, BridgeFSETMax, T!SMTT("r30")
  <2>3. FSET!Min(fps) \in fps BY MinFpsIn, BridgeFSETMin, T!SMTT("r30")
  <2>4. QED BY <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, MaxFpsGe, T!SMTT("r30")
<1>2. max(fps) # min(fps)
  <2>1. CASE max(fps) = min(fps)
    <3>1. fps = {min(fps)}
      <4>1. min(fps) \in fps BY MinFpsIn, BridgeMin, BridgeFSETMin, T!SMTT("r30")
      <4>2. FSET!Max(fps) = FSET!Min(fps) BY <2>1, BridgeMax, BridgeMin, BridgeFSETMax, BridgeFSETMin, T!SMTT("r30")
      <4>3. \A y \in fps : y = min(fps)
        <5> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW y \in fps PROVE y = min(fps)
          OBVIOUS
        <5>1. y <= FSET!Max(fps) /\ FSET!Min(fps) <= y BY MaxFpsGe, MinFpsLe, T!SMTT("r30")
        <5>2. min(fps) = FSET!Min(fps) BY BridgeMin, BridgeFSETMin, T!SMTT("r30")
        <5>2b. FSET!Max(fps) \in Int /\ FSET!Min(fps) \in Int BY MaxFpsIn, MinFpsIn, FpsSubsetInt, T!SMTT("r30")
        <5>3. QED BY <4>2, <5>1, <5>2, <5>2b, MinFpsInt, FpsSubsetInt, T!SMTT("r30")
      <4>4. QED BY <4>1, <4>3, T!SetExtensionality, T!SMTT("r30")
    <3>2. Cardinality(fps) = 1 BY <3>1, BridgeCard, BridgeFSETCard, FS!FS_Singleton, T!SMTT("r30")
    <3>3. QED BY <3>2, OAAssumption, T!SMTT("r30")
  <2>2. QED BY <2>1
<1>3. QED BY <1>1, <1>2, T!SMTT("r30")

LEMMA KPos == K \in Nat \ {0}
  BY OAAssumption, T!SMTT("r30")
LEMMA LNat == L \in Nat
  BY OAAssumption, T!SMTT("r30")
LEMMA ModRange == \A i \in Int : \A len \in Nat \ {0} : mod(i, len) \in 1..len
  BY T!SMTT("r30") DEF mod
LEMMA FunUpdateType == \A D, R, f, a, b : (f \in [D -> R] /\ a \in D /\ b \in R) => [f EXCEPT ![a] = b] \in [D -> R]
  BY T!SMTT("r30")
LEMMA RescaleRange == \A k \in Nat \ {0} : \A maxF \in Int : \A minF \in Int : (maxF > minF) => \A a \in Int : \A pp \in Int : rescale(k, maxF, minF, a, pp) \in 1..k
<1> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW k \in Nat \ {0}, NEW maxF \in Int, NEW minF \in Int, maxF > minF, NEW a \in Int, NEW pp \in Int PROVE rescale(k, maxF, minF, a, pp) \in 1..k
  OBVIOUS
<1>1. ((k - 1) \div (maxF - minF)) \in Int BY T!SMTT("r30")
<1>2. (((k - 1) \div (maxF - minF)) * (a - minF + 1)) + pp \in Int BY <1>1, T!SMTT("r30")
<1>3. QED BY <1>2, ModRange, T!SMTT("r30") DEF rescale
LEMMA IdxRange == \A a \in Int : \A pp \in Int : idx(a, pp) \in 1..K
<1> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW a \in Int, NEW pp \in Int PROVE idx(a, pp) \in 1..K
  OBVIOUS
<1>1. QED BY KPos, MaxFpsInt, MinFpsInt, MaxGtMin, RescaleRange, T!SMTT("r30") DEF idx
CPcType == pc \in [ProcSet -> {"pick","put","waitEv","endWEv","chkSnc","cntns","onSnc","insrt","isMth","cas","tryEv","waitIns","endEv","strIns","nestedIns","set","flush","rtrn","Done"}]
CFpType == fp \in [Writer -> (fps \cup {0})]
CHist == history \in SUBSET fps
CA3 == \A self \in Writer : pc[self] \notin {"pick", "Done"} => fp[self] \in fps
CEi == ei \in [ProcSet -> Nat]
CEj == ej \in [ProcSet -> Int]
CLo == lo \in [ProcSet -> (Int \cup {empty})]
CTable == table \in [1..K -> (Int \cup {empty})]
CStack == stack \in [ProcSet -> Seq([procedure: {"Evict"}, pc: {"endEv"}, ei: Nat, ej: Int, lo: (Int \cup {empty})])]
CEvictEv == \A self \in ProcSet : pc[self] \in {"strIns","nestedIns","set","flush","rtrn","waitIns","endEv"} => evict = TRUE
CEvictStack == \A self \in ProcSet : pc[self] \in {"strIns","nestedIns","set","flush","rtrn"} => stack[self] # <<>>
CIndex == index \in [Writer -> (Int \cup {empty})]
CExpected == expected \in [Writer -> (Int \cup {empty})]
CResult == result \in [Writer -> BOOLEAN]
CWaitCnt == waitCnt \in Int
CEvictBool == evict \in BOOLEAN
CE23 == \A self \in Writer : pc[self] \in {"chkSnc", "cntns", "onSnc"} => expected[self] \in Int /\ index[self] \in Int
CE3 == \A self \in Writer : pc[self] \in {"insrt", "isMth", "cas"} => index[self] \in Int
WCnt2 == waitCnt = FS!Cardinality({s \in Writer : pc[s] = "waitEv" \/ pc[s] = "endWEv"})
WCntFin == FS!IsFiniteSet({s \in Writer : pc[s] = "waitEv" \/ pc[s] = "endWEv"})

LEMMA WriterFiniteFS == FS!IsFiniteSet(Writer)
  BY WriterFinite, BridgeFin

THEOREM WCntFinInit == Init => WCntFin
<1>1. {s \in Writer : pc[s] = "waitEv" \/ pc[s] = "endWEv"} \in SUBSET Writer BY T!SMTT("r30")
<1>2. FS!IsFiniteSet(Writer) BY WriterFinite, BridgeFin
<1>3. PICK S0 \in SUBSET Writer : S0 = {s \in Writer : pc[s] = "waitEv" \/ pc[s] = "endWEv"} BY <1>1
<1>4. FS!IsFiniteSet(S0) BY <1>3, <1>2, FS!FS_Subset, T!SMTT("r30")
<1>5a. FS!IsFiniteSet({s \in Writer : pc[s] = "waitEv" \/ pc[s] = "endWEv"}) BY <1>4, <1>3, T!SMTT("r30")
<1>5. QED BY <1>5a DEF WCntFin

THEOREM WCnt2Init == Init => WCnt2
<1> SUFFICES ASSUME Init PROVE WCnt2
  OBVIOUS
<1>1. pc = [self \in ProcSet |-> "pick"] BY DEF Init
<1>2. waitCnt = 0 BY DEF Init
<1>3. \A s \in Writer : pc[s] = "pick" BY <1>1, T!SMTT("r30") DEF ProcSet
<1>4. {s \in Writer : pc[s] = "waitEv" \/ pc[s] = "endWEv"} = {} BY <1>3, T!SetExtensionality, T!SMTT("r30")
<1>5. FS!Cardinality({s \in Writer : pc[s] = "waitEv" \/ pc[s] = "endWEv"}) = 0 BY <1>4, FS!FS_EmptySet, T!SMTT("r30")
<1>6. QED BY <1>2, <1>5, T!SMTT("r30") DEF WCnt2

CInv == CPcType /\ CFpType /\ CHist /\ CA3 /\ CEi /\ CEj /\ CLo /\ CTable /\ CStack /\ CEvictStack /\ CIndex /\ CExpected /\ CResult /\ CWaitCnt /\ CEvictBool /\ CE23 /\ CE3 /\ WCnt2 /\ WCntFin /\ CompleteAsSafety

THEOREM InitCInv == Init => CInv
  BY WCnt2Init, WCntFinInit, T!SMTT("r30") DEF Init, CInv, CPcType, CFpType, CHist, CA3, CEi, CEj, CLo, CTable, CStack, CEvictEv, CEvictStack, CIndex, CExpected, CResult, CWaitCnt, CEvictBool, CE23, CE3, WCnt2, WCntFin, CompleteAsSafety, ProcSet
THEOREM PcNext == (CPcType /\ CStack /\ CEvictStack) /\ Next => CPcType'
  BY T!SMTT("r30") DEF CPcType, CStack, CEvictStack, Next, vars, ProcSet, Evict, p, pick, put, waitEv, endWEv, chkSnc, cntns, onSnc, insrt, isMth, cas, tryEv, waitIns, endEv, strIns, nestedIns, set, flush, rtrn, Terminating
THEOREM FpNext == CFpType /\ Next => CFpType'
  BY T!SMTT("r30") DEF CFpType, Next, vars, ProcSet, Evict, p, pick, put, waitEv, endWEv, chkSnc, cntns, onSnc, insrt, isMth, cas, tryEv, waitIns, endEv, strIns, nestedIns, set, flush, rtrn, Terminating
THEOREM HistNext == (CHist /\ CA3 /\ CFpType /\ CPcType) /\ Next => CHist'
  BY T!SMTT("r30") DEF CHist, CA3, CFpType, CPcType, Next, vars, ProcSet, Evict, p, pick, put, waitEv, endWEv, chkSnc, cntns, onSnc, insrt, isMth, cas, tryEv, waitIns, endEv, strIns, nestedIns, set, flush, rtrn, Terminating
THEOREM StackNext == (CStack /\ CEi /\ CEj /\ CLo /\ CPcType /\ CEvictStack) /\ Next => CStack'
<1> SUFFICES ASSUME CStack, CEi, CEj, CLo, CPcType, CEvictStack, Next PROVE CStack'
  OBVIOUS
<1>1. CASE \E self \in Writer : waitIns(self)
  <2>1. PICK self \in Writer : waitIns(self) BY <1>1
  <2>2. stack' = [stack EXCEPT ![self] = <<[procedure |-> "Evict", pc |-> "endEv", ei |-> ei[self], ej |-> ej[self], lo |-> lo[self]]>> \o stack[self]] BY <2>1 DEF waitIns
  <2>3. [procedure |-> "Evict", pc |-> "endEv", ei |-> ei[self], ej |-> ej[self], lo |-> lo[self]] \in [procedure: {"Evict"}, pc: {"endEv"}, ei: Nat, ej: Int, lo: (Int \cup {empty})] BY T!SMTT("r30") DEF CEi, CEj, CLo, ProcSet
  <2>4. stack[self] \in Seq([procedure: {"Evict"}, pc: {"endEv"}, ei: Nat, ej: Int, lo: (Int \cup {empty})]) BY T!SMTT("r30") DEF CStack, ProcSet
  <2>5. stack \in [ProcSet -> Seq([procedure: {"Evict"}, pc: {"endEv"}, ei: Nat, ej: Int, lo: (Int \cup {empty})])] BY T!SMTT("r30") DEF CStack
  <2>6. QED BY <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, <2>4, <2>5, FunUpdateType, T!SMTT("r30") DEF CStack, ProcSet
<1>2. CASE \E self \in ProcSet : rtrn(self)
  <2>1. PICK self \in ProcSet : rtrn(self) BY <1>2
  <2>2. stack' = [stack EXCEPT ![self] = Tail(stack[self])] BY <2>1 DEF rtrn
  <2>3. stack[self] # <<>> BY <2>1, T!SMTT("r30") DEF CEvictStack, rtrn
  <2>4. Tail(stack[self]) \in Seq([procedure: {"Evict"}, pc: {"endEv"}, ei: Nat, ej: Int, lo: (Int \cup {empty})]) BY <2>3, T!SMTT("r30") DEF CStack, CEvictStack, ProcSet
  <2>5. stack \in [ProcSet -> Seq([procedure: {"Evict"}, pc: {"endEv"}, ei: Nat, ej: Int, lo: (Int \cup {empty})])] BY T!SMTT("r30") DEF CStack
  <2>6. QED BY <2>1, <2>2, <2>4, <2>5, FunUpdateType, T!SMTT("r30") DEF CStack, ProcSet
<1>3. CASE (\E self \in Writer : pick(self) \/ put(self) \/ waitEv(self) \/ endWEv(self) \/ chkSnc(self) \/ cntns(self) \/ onSnc(self) \/ insrt(self) \/ isMth(self) \/ cas(self) \/ tryEv(self) \/ endEv(self)) \/ (\E self \in ProcSet : strIns(self) \/ nestedIns(self) \/ set(self) \/ flush(self)) \/ Terminating
  BY <1>3, T!SMTT("r30") DEF CStack, CEi, CEj, CLo, CPcType, CEvictStack, pick, put, waitEv, endWEv, chkSnc, cntns, onSnc, insrt, isMth, cas, tryEv, endEv, strIns, nestedIns, set, flush, Terminating, vars, ProcSet
<1>4. QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3 DEF Next, Evict, p
THEOREM EiNext == (CEi /\ CStack /\ CPcType /\ CEvictStack) /\ Next => CEi'
  BY T!SMTT("r30") DEF CEi, CStack, CPcType, CEvictStack, Next, vars, ProcSet, Evict, p, pick, put, waitEv, endWEv, chkSnc, cntns, onSnc, insrt, isMth, cas, tryEv, waitIns, endEv, strIns, nestedIns, set, flush, rtrn, Terminating
THEOREM EjNext == (CEj /\ CEi /\ CStack /\ CPcType /\ CEvictStack) /\ Next => CEj'
  BY T!SMTT("r30") DEF CEj, CEi, CStack, CPcType, CEvictStack, Next, vars, ProcSet, Evict, p, pick, put, waitEv, endWEv, chkSnc, cntns, onSnc, insrt, isMth, cas, tryEv, waitIns, endEv, strIns, nestedIns, set, flush, rtrn, Terminating
THEOREM A3Next == (CA3 /\ CFpType /\ CPcType) /\ Next => CA3'
  BY T!SMTT("r30") DEF CA3, CFpType, CPcType, Next, vars, ProcSet, Evict, p, pick, put, waitEv, endWEv, chkSnc, cntns, onSnc, insrt, isMth, cas, tryEv, waitIns, endEv, strIns, nestedIns, set, flush, rtrn, Terminating
THEOREM EvStackNext == (CEvictStack /\ CStack /\ CPcType) /\ Next => CEvictStack'
  BY T!SMTT("r30") DEF CEvictStack, CStack, CPcType, Next, vars, ProcSet, Evict, p, pick, put, waitEv, endWEv, chkSnc, cntns, onSnc, insrt, isMth, cas, tryEv, waitIns, endEv, strIns, nestedIns, set, flush, rtrn, Terminating
THEOREM IndexNext == (CIndex /\ CExpected /\ CPcType /\ CE23 /\ CE3) /\ Next => CIndex'
<1> SUFFICES ASSUME CIndex, CExpected, CPcType, CE23, CE3, Next PROVE CIndex'
  OBVIOUS
<1>1. CASE \E self \in Writer : put(self)
  <2>1. PICK self \in Writer : put(self) BY <1>1
  <2>2. index' = [index EXCEPT ![self] = 0] BY <2>1 DEF put
  <2>3. index \in [Writer -> (Int \cup {empty})] BY T!SMTT("r30") DEF CIndex
  <2>4. QED BY <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, FunUpdateType, T!SMTT("r30") DEF CIndex, ProcSet
<1>2. CASE \E self \in Writer : cntns(self)
  <2>1. PICK self \in Writer : cntns(self) BY <1>2
  <2>2. pc[self] = "cntns" BY <2>1, T!SMTT("r30") DEF cntns
  <2>3. index[self] \in Int BY <2>2, T!SMTT("r30") DEF CE23
  <2>4. index' = index \/ index' = [index EXCEPT ![self] = index[self] + 1] BY <2>1, T!SMTT("r30") DEF cntns
  <2>5. CASE index' = index
    <3>1. QED BY <2>5, T!SMTT("r30") DEF CIndex
  <2>6. CASE index' = [index EXCEPT ![self] = index[self] + 1]
    <3>1. index \in [Writer -> (Int \cup {empty})] BY T!SMTT("r30") DEF CIndex
    <3>2. index[self] + 1 \in (Int \cup {empty}) BY <2>3, T!SMTT("r30")
    <3>3. QED BY <2>1, <2>6, <3>1, <3>2, FunUpdateType, T!SMTT("r30") DEF CIndex, ProcSet
  <2>7. QED BY <2>4, <2>5, <2>6
<1>3. CASE \E self \in Writer : onSnc(self)
  <2>1. PICK self \in Writer : onSnc(self) BY <1>3
  <2>2. index' = index \/ index' = [index EXCEPT ![self] = expected[self]] BY <2>1, T!SMTT("r30") DEF onSnc
  <2>3. CASE index' = index
    <3>1. QED BY <2>3, T!SMTT("r30") DEF CIndex
  <2>4. CASE index' = [index EXCEPT ![self] = expected[self]]
    <3>1. index \in [Writer -> (Int \cup {empty})] BY T!SMTT("r30") DEF CIndex
    <3>2. expected[self] \in (Int \cup {empty}) BY T!SMTT("r30") DEF CExpected
    <3>3. QED BY <2>1, <2>4, <3>1, <3>2, FunUpdateType, T!SMTT("r30") DEF CIndex, ProcSet
  <2>5. QED BY <2>2, <2>3, <2>4
<1>4. CASE \E self \in Writer : isMth(self)
  <2>1. PICK self \in Writer : isMth(self) BY <1>4
  <2>2. pc[self] = "isMth" BY <2>1, T!SMTT("r30") DEF isMth
  <2>3. index[self] \in Int BY <2>2, T!SMTT("r30") DEF CE3
  <2>4. index' = index \/ index' = [index EXCEPT ![self] = index[self] + 1] BY <2>1, T!SMTT("r30") DEF isMth
  <2>5. CASE index' = index
    <3>1. QED BY <2>5, T!SMTT("r30") DEF CIndex
  <2>6. CASE index' = [index EXCEPT ![self] = index[self] + 1]
    <3>1. index \in [Writer -> (Int \cup {empty})] BY T!SMTT("r30") DEF CIndex
    <3>2. index[self] + 1 \in (Int \cup {empty}) BY <2>3, T!SMTT("r30")
    <3>3. QED BY <2>1, <2>6, <3>1, <3>2, FunUpdateType, T!SMTT("r30") DEF CIndex, ProcSet
  <2>7. QED BY <2>4, <2>5, <2>6
<1>5. CASE (\E self \in Writer : pick(self) \/ waitEv(self) \/ endWEv(self) \/ chkSnc(self) \/ insrt(self) \/ cas(self) \/ tryEv(self) \/ waitIns(self) \/ endEv(self)) \/ (\E self \in ProcSet : strIns(self) \/ nestedIns(self) \/ set(self) \/ flush(self) \/ rtrn(self)) \/ Terminating
  BY <1>5, T!SMTT("r30") DEF CIndex, CExpected, CPcType, CE23, CE3, pick, waitEv, endWEv, chkSnc, insrt, cas, tryEv, waitIns, endEv, strIns, nestedIns, set, flush, rtrn, Terminating, vars, ProcSet
<1>6. QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>4, <1>5 DEF Next, Evict, p
THEOREM ResultNext == CResult /\ Next => CResult'
  BY T!SMTT("r30") DEF CResult, Next, vars, ProcSet, Evict, p, pick, put, waitEv, endWEv, chkSnc, cntns, onSnc, insrt, isMth, cas, tryEv, waitIns, endEv, strIns, nestedIns, set, flush, rtrn, Terminating
THEOREM WaitCntNext == CWaitCnt /\ Next => CWaitCnt'
  BY T!SMTT("r30") DEF CWaitCnt, Next, vars, ProcSet, Evict, p, pick, put, waitEv, endWEv, chkSnc, cntns, onSnc, insrt, isMth, cas, tryEv, waitIns, endEv, strIns, nestedIns, set, flush, rtrn, Terminating
THEOREM EvictBoolNext == CEvictBool /\ Next => CEvictBool'
  BY T!SMTT("r30") DEF CEvictBool, Next, vars, ProcSet, Evict, p, pick, put, waitEv, endWEv, chkSnc, cntns, onSnc, insrt, isMth, cas, tryEv, waitIns, endEv, strIns, nestedIns, set, flush, rtrn, Terminating
THEOREM E3Next == (CE3 /\ CE23 /\ CIndex /\ CPcType /\ CStack /\ CEvictStack) /\ Next => CE3'
<1> SUFFICES ASSUME CE3, CE23, CIndex, CPcType, CStack, CEvictStack, Next PROVE CE3'
  OBVIOUS
<1>1. CASE \E self \in Writer : chkSnc(self)
  <2>1. PICK self \in Writer : chkSnc(self) BY <1>1
  <2>2. index' = index BY <2>1 DEF chkSnc
  <2>3. pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "cntns"] \/ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "insrt"] BY <2>1 DEF chkSnc
  <2>4. pc[self] = "chkSnc" BY <2>1, T!SMTT("r30") DEF chkSnc
  <2>5. index[self] \in Int BY <2>4, T!SMTT("r30") DEF CE23
  <2>6. \A s \in Writer : pc'[s] \in {"insrt", "isMth", "cas"} => index'[s] \in Int
    <3> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW s \in Writer, pc'[s] \in {"insrt", "isMth", "cas"} PROVE index'[s] \in Int
      OBVIOUS
    <3>1. CASE s = self
      <4>1. pc'[s] = "insrt" BY <3>1, <2>3, T!SMTT("r30") DEF CPcType, ProcSet
      <4>2. index'[s] = index[s] BY <3>1, <2>2, T!SMTT("r30") DEF CIndex, ProcSet
      <4>3. QED BY <3>1, <4>1, <4>2, <2>5, T!SMTT("r30")
